module.name: Wake Up Calls
module.description: FreePBX module for generating reminder and wakeup calls
module.changelog: *16.0.10* The Time field in the Add/Edit Wakeup Call modal now always displays/accepts 24h format (e.g. "14:30") instead of the jquery.timepicker plugin's default 12h "2:30 pm". Added a "Wakeup Time Step" setting (5/10/15/30 minutes, default 15) on ?display=hotelwakeup_settings controlling the granularity of the times offered in the Time dropdown -- typing an exact time still always works regardless of this setting. Added cache-busting (filemtime-based version query string) to the wakeup.js/settings.js/global.js/messages.js includes: without it, a browser tab left open across a module update kept running the previous JS, which on the Settings page silently dropped any field the stale script didn't know to send and surfaced as a "missing parameters" save error. Fixed the "Enable repeat options" / weekday checkboxes and the selected Language dropdown item highlighting in the Add/Edit Wakeup Call modal rendering with the browser's default blue accent instead of the FreePBX theme color. *16.0.9* FREEPBX-24236 *16.0.8* FREEPBX-23913 *16.0.7* FREEPBX-23913 *16.0.6* FREEPBX-23910 and FREEPBX-23773 *16.0.5* FREEPBX-23854 *16.0.4* Reverting Bootstrap and dependent libs fixes *16.0.3* FREEI-4793 *16.0.2* FREEPBX-23261: Fix crash to exec *16.0.1* 16.0
